- **Adopted at exact scope:**

Classical five-families are allowed. The historical missing-support MINOR remains; current `W1/R-M1` requires the complete four-row case analysis, not the budget alone, to obtain an `a12/f4` member. Serial/process findings remain.

  - For arbitrary ordinary four-families, `GAP3`, intrinsic `C2/C3` exclusions and the stated local-span bounds hold; all-four-nonclassical families have span sum at most 53 and, by the parent-checked composition, at least nine fixed rays. An all-light member is classical, and a nonclassical member has at least four heavy cells in every frame. Two v167-B MINORs remain.
  - The rational quaternion selected `QLS8` has the stated transition profile but no classical mate; it is not a `q3` witness or a full companion family.

Numerical M8, native UNKNOWN cases and finite-witness/A10/A11/stronger gates remain distinct from the written five-family theorem. STOP91, prior protected exposures and the v260 administrative held-display/consumers ZERO persist; v262 records a distinct 58m02 cadence PROCESS MAJOR, separate from v238’s overlapping earlier finding.
- **Original problem:** The registered original five-family classicality statement is WRITTEN_SUPPORTED at its named ordinary inputs. The unrestricted four-family existence/no-go question, numerical `M(8)`, A10/A11 and stronger acceptance remain open; no maximum-three conclusion is made.
